A runtime defect: the running program stops with it; no compile phase reports it, and `try` cannot catch it. `sakura explain D096` prints this explanation offline.

The WASM runtime's heap limit (`runtime/rt/ABI.md` §13) was reached or memory could not grow.
The task ends without running further user code. Reduce live data.

Runtime defects come from running programs, so `compiler/tests/ui` has no fixture for them; the explanation above names the repair.
